title: The Real Cost of a Six-Wheel Truck
description:
A Mercedes G 63 AMG 6x6 cost about five hundred eleven thousand dollars new, and one sold at auction in twenty twenty for over nine hundred thousand. So what does a six-wheel truck really cost? The purchase price is only the start. In this video we work through fuel, tyres, mileage limits and resale, using published numbers, and we show where the sources go quiet. Our sources are Autocar, Fox News, Wikipedia, Gear Patrol, The Drive, Motor Authority, Carscoops, MercedesBlog, Ford Authority, DuPont Registry, a tyre retailer, and the Energy Information Administration. Some figures are estimates, and some of our calculations rest on assumptions that we state. Our own arithmetic is labelled.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.

0:00 Intro
0:57 The sticker
3:12 Fuel
7:13 Tyres
9:16 Mileage and the law
11:03 Weight, and what it means
11:57 What it is worth
14:35 The cost per mile
16:17 What the early drives said
17:57 The costs nobody published
19:33 A simple cost sheet
21:20 What our sources do not say
